title: Further appointments to committees under Hong Kong Maritime and Port Development Board
content:
Further appointments to committees under Hong Kong Maritime and Port Development Board29 August 2025
Further to the Government's announcement of the appointments to four committees under the Hong Kong Maritime and Port Development Board (HKMPDB) on June 30, the Government today (August 29) announced the addition of more members for broader inclusion of industry and stakeholders' inputs.
The term of appointment of these newly added members will last until June 30, 2028. The four committees will respectively convene their first meetings in September.
Information of the newly added members is as follows, and the full membership list can be found on the HKMPDB's website.
